title: Epoch and counting units for Windows FILETIME
summary: FILETIME is the number of 100 nanosecond intervals since UTC 1601-01-01, consisting of two 32-bit words, high and low.
applies: Units and epochs of common timestamp fields
detail: The Unix epoch corresponds to FILETIME 116444736000000000. When converting, first subtract the epoch difference and then divide by 10000000 to avoid mistaking the field for milliseconds.
boundary: The field unit is not equal to the actual record accuracy of the file system; the splicing of the upper and lower DWORDs must also comply with the structural layout.
relevance: Put Windows file metadata on the same timeline as Unix logs.
